answer: Give every agent a hardware-bound identity card. First it passes a TPM attestation proving it runs on one unique device, then it locks 0.02 BNB in a vault for 30 days. A new identity earns nothing until a random jury of five established agents clears it. The bond returns only after 30 days of clean behavior. Spinning up 1,000 fakes would need 1,000 real TPM chips, about $15,000 in hardware, plus 20 BNB locked for a month. That kills the old fable of free identities. A sybil farm is a vine trying to climb a basalt cliff, and without real roots it slides straight back down.
